test.title: Your first week at Hartley Logistics

texts.title: Your first week at Hartley Logistics

paragraphs.text: On your first day, please arrive at 8.45 am and report to the security desk at the main entrance, where you will receive a temporary pass. Your permanent photo pass will be ready by the end of the week.

The morning will be spent with the Human Resources team, who will go through your contract and explain the pension scheme. Please bring your bank details and a form of identification so that you can be added to the payroll.

In the afternoon you will complete a health and safety course. This is compulsory for all new staff, including those who will work only in the office, and you will not be allowed into the warehouse until you have passed it.

Staff can buy lunch in the canteen on the ground floor or use the kitchen on each floor to prepare their own food. Free parking is available, but the spaces near the entrance are reserved for visitors.

items.quote: where you will receive a temporary pass
items.prompt: On their first day, new staff will receive

explanation.en: “you will receive a temporary pass” → B. The permanent pass (A) is only ready at the end of the week.
explanation.kk: «you will receive a temporary pass» → B. Тұрақты рұқсатнама (A) аптаның соңында ғана дайын болады.
explanation.ru: «you will receive a temporary pass» → B. Постоянный пропуск (A) будет готов только к концу недели.

groups.instruction: Question 1. Look at the text. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: Please bring your bank details and a form of identification
items.prompt: Which TWO things should new staff bring on their first day?

explanation.en: “Please bring your bank details and a form of identification” → A and C. The contract (D) is explained by HR, not brought; a photo (B) and lunch (E) are not required.
explanation.kk: «Please bring your bank details and a form of identification» → A және C. Келісімшартты (D) кадр бөлімі түсіндіреді, оны әкелу керек емес; фото (B) мен түскі ас (E) талап етілмейді.
explanation.ru: «Please bring your bank details and a form of identification» → A и C. Контракт (D) обсудят с отделом кадров, приносить его не нужно; фото (B) и обед (E) не требуются.

groups.instruction: Questions 2–3. Look at the text. Choose TWO letters, A–E.

items.quote: you will not be allowed into the warehouse until you have passed it

options.text: must be passed before entering the warehouse.

explanation.en: “you will not be allowed into the warehouse until you have passed it” → C. It is compulsory for office staff too (A, D wrong) and happens in the afternoon (B).
explanation.kk: «you will not be allowed into the warehouse until you have passed it» → C. Курс кеңседегілерге де міндетті (A, D қате), түстен кейін өтеді (B).
explanation.ru: «you will not be allowed into the warehouse until you have passed it» → C. Курс обязателен и для офиса (A, D неверны), а проходит днём (B).

items.quote: Free parking is available, but the spaces near the entrance are reserved for visitors

options.text: can use the spaces near the entrance.

explanation.en: “Free parking is available” → C. The spaces near the entrance (B) are for visitors.
explanation.kk: «Free parking is available» → C. Кіреберіс маңындағы орын (B) келушілерге арналған.
explanation.ru: «Free parking is available» → C. Места у входа (B) — для посетителей.
